svg.title: Embeddings place tokens in a semantic space
svg.desc: A simplified two-dimensional view of word embeddings. Man, woman, king and queen sit along one row, with the man-to-woman and king-to-queen arrows pointing the same way. Cat and dog form a separate cluster elsewhere.
